headline: Committee to hold executive session to screen applicants for City Council Budget/Management Analyst position.
summary: The committee will meet in executive session to review and interview applicants for the City Council Budget/Management Analyst position, then reconvene in open session to announce a finalist and schedule finalist interviews with the full City Council.
items: Executive session to consider or interview applicants for the Budget/Management Analyst position
Announcement of finalist for the City Council Budget/Management Analyst position
Announcement of dates for finalist interviews with the full City Council
location: Beverly Public Library — Fogg Room, 32 Essex Street, Beverly, MA 01915
